##### Project general facts

Azizi Sakandar by Azizi Developments is a contemporary residential building with a modern design that opens up panoramic views of the city. Clean lines, balconies and generous glazing give the building a bright, elegant presence within an established community. It rises above three basement levels, a ground floor and two podium levels to eleven residential floors and a roof, offering modern studios and one- and two-bedroom apartments together with retail units at street level.

Residents enjoy a swimming pool with a poolside terrace, a state-of-the-art gym, a sauna and a steam room for everyday wellness. A modern cinema, an indoor multipurpose hall, indoor and outdoor children's play areas, recreation and social zones add variety, while accessible facilities, a welcoming lobby, lifts, covered parking and round-the-clock security with video surveillance provide comfort and peace of mind for residents and their guests.

Interiors combine elegance with a contemporary style, featuring practical layouts, quality finishes and large windows that bring natural light into the living spaces. Compact, efficient floor plans suit young professionals, couples and investors seeking well-located city homes. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fitted kitchens and appliances and built-in wardrobes, leaving loose furniture to the owner's own taste and style.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Furjan is an established family-friendly community in western Dubai, known for its mix of villas, townhouses and low-rise apartment buildings in Arabic, Mediterranean and contemporary styles. Landscaped parks, playgrounds, sports courts, cycling and jogging tracks and community retail centres with cafes, supermarkets and clinics cover daily needs close to home and give the area a calm, green character.

Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Sheikh Zayed Road connect residents with the wider city, and the Al Furjan metro station is close by. Ibn Battuta Mall and the Jebel Ali Free Zone are a short drive away, Dubai Marina, Jumeirah Beach Residence, Palm Jumeirah and Expo City Dubai are close by, and the Dubai International Financial Centre, Business Bay and Al Maktoum International Airport are within comfortable reach.

Al Furjan is a freehold community open to international buyers and one of the most popular addresses in western Dubai. Metro access, mature infrastructure and proximity to Dubai Marina and the Jebel Ali Free Zone attract young professionals and families, supporting high occupancy. Compact studios and one-bedroom homes at competitive prices underpin steady rental demand, attractive yields and long-term value for investors.
